checks.label: Guest Account Exists
checks.remediation: Remove the guest account via Settings - System - Multiple Users or run 'pm remove-user <guest-id>'.

checks.label: Work Profile
checks.remediation: Set up a work profile via your EMM/MDM console to isolate corporate data from personal apps.

checks.label: Sync Accounts
checks.remediation: Review synced accounts in Settings - Accounts and remove any that are unauthorized or unnecessary.

checks.label: Developer Options Disabled
checks.description: Developer options should be disabled in production
checks.remediation: Disable developer options via Settings - Developer Options toggle or run 'settings put global development_settings_enabled 0'.

checks.label: Stay Awake Disabled
checks.description: Stay awake while charging can be a security risk
checks.remediation: Disable stay awake via Settings - Developer Options or run 'settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 0'.

checks.label: Mock Location Disabled
checks.remediation: Disable mock locations in Settings - Developer Options or run 'settings put secure mock_location 0'.

checks.label: Device Admin Apps
checks.remediation: Review admin apps in Settings - Security - Device Admin Apps and revoke any unrecognized administrators.

checks.label: Enterprise Encryption
checks.remediation: Enforce full-disk or file-based encryption via your MDM policy or Settings - Security - Encryption.

checks.label: Accessibility Master Flag Enabled
checks.description: The global accessibility_enabled master flag (distinct from the INPUT category 'Accessibility Services Enabled' check, which lists the specific enabled services). Accessibility on kiosk or POS devices can be abused to bypass lock task mode, simulate user input, or exfiltrate screen content.
checks.remediation: Disable accessibility services via 'settings put secure accessibility_enabled 0' or block them via MDM policy.
